cues: Before starting, a rider swings a leg over the frame and settles onto the saddle.
The rider presses the pedals in steady strokes, rolling forward along a paved path.
At a junction, the rider extends an arm to signal a turn to nearby drivers.
Riders lean into a bend, guiding the front wheel around the curve without losing balance.
To cross a shallow curb, the rider briefly lifts the front wheel and rolls onward.
At a traffic signal, the rider stops and plants one foot on the ground while waiting.
